# Synthea FHIR R4 Source: Profiling Findings and Load Decisions

**Source:** Synthea FHIR R4 bundles, `data/source/synthea/fhir` (the plan's current clinical/claims feed)
**Profile report:** `docs/profiling/fhir_profile.md` (generated by `ingestion/fhir/profile_fhir.py`)
**Load config:** `ingestion/fhir/fhir_sources.yaml`
**Status:** v2, open questions answered by `sql/investigations/04_fhir_open_questions.sql` (output: `docs/profiling/fhir_open_questions.txt`)

## Volumes

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Files | 1,170 (1,168 patient bundles, 2 shared reference bundles, 0 unreadable) |
| Resources (bundle entries) | 1,840,768 |
| Raw size | 5.4 GB (largest bundle 63.9 MB) |
| Coverage | Encounters and claims 1917-04-18 to 2026-10-13 (lifetime histories) |

## Findings and rules

| # | Finding | Evidence | Rule | Layer |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| H1 | One bundle per patient plus two shared bundles | `hospitalInformation*` (Organization, Location), `practitionerInformation*` (Practitioner, PractitionerRole) | Classify files by **content** (contains a Patient or not), never by file name: names contain accents (`Adán600_…`) that broke a name-pattern check | Bronze |
| H2 | Financial resources dominate volume | ExplanationOfBenefit 36.5%, Claim 9.1% (151,490 each: one EOB per Claim) | Both loaded. Claim ↔ EOB one-to-one is a silver test | Bronze, Silver |
| H3 | Free-text clinical notes present | DocumentReference 79,317 (7.1%), one per Encounter | **Not loaded**: HIPAA minimum necessary; no planned use needs note text | Bronze |
| H4 | Clinical results are large but out of scope | Observation 20.1%, DiagnosticReport 9.4%, ImagingStudy 1.0% | Not loaded now; counted per file in the manifest. Add to `load_resource_types` when a quality measure needs them | Bronze |
| H5 | **No ICD-10-CM or CPT anywhere** | Condition, Procedure, Encounter: 100% SNOMED CT. Claim/EOB items: SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, CVX | Diagnoses need SNOMED CT → ICD-10-CM conversion (**CONV-4**) before HCC risk and before 837 generation. Procedures need a SNOMED → CPT/HCPCS crosswalk for 837 (**EDI-1**) | Silver |
| H6 | Lifetime history, not a plan-year extract | Dates from 1917 | Bronze and silver keep all history. Gold metrics use an explicit reporting window (decision in GOLD-1); members are counted only while enrolled | Gold |
| H7 | Every bundle is a full snapshot of one patient | Synthea regenerates whole bundles | A changed file **replaces** its earlier rows (delete by `_source_file`, then insert, in one transaction) | Bronze |

## Bronze design

- **Table:** `bronze.fhir_resource`, one row per resource: `resource_type`, `resource_id`, `full_url`, `resource JSONB` (unchanged), plus `_batch_id`, `_source_file`, `_source_entry_num`, `_loaded_at`.
- **Why JSONB and not a table per resource type:** FHIR resources are deeply nested and vary by type; flattening belongs in silver, where the mapping is documented and tested. Bronze stores exactly what arrived.
- **Per-file reconciliation** (rolls back the file on mismatch):
  - bundle entries = loaded + skipped (skipped counted by type in `audit.load_manifest.message`)
  - loaded resources = database rows for the batch
  - Σ `Claim.total.value` in the file = Σ computed from JSONB in the database
- **Failure isolation:** one transaction per file; a bad file is logged `FAILED` and the rest still load.

## Findings from discovery (FHIR-2)

| # | Finding | Evidence | Rule | Layer |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| H8 | Three FHIR claim types | professional 74,031 ($226.3M); pharmacy 72,173 ($21.4M, one per MedicationRequest); institutional 5,286 ($64.0M) | Canonical `claim_type`: PROF, RX, and institutional split into IP / OP by the billed Encounter's class (IMP, ACUTE, NONAC = inpatient). Original value kept in `source_claim_type` | Silver |
| H9 | Pharmacy claims are never paid through the EOB | 72,173 EOBs with payment 0 = exactly the 72,173 pharmacy claims | RX `paid_amount` stays 0 as received; pharmacy cost uses `billed_amount`. Zero-paid RX is not a denial | Silver, Gold |
| H10 | Ten payers including self-pay | Medicare 78,099 claims; Aetna, Anthem, Cigna, Humana, BCBS, UHC; Medicaid 4,006; Dual Eligible 355; NO_INSURANCE 15,109 ($29.8M) | `payer_name` carried to silver for every source (DE-SynPUF = Medicare). Gold maps payers to line of business; self-pay is excluded from plan PMPM | Silver, Gold |
| H11 | Claim ↔ EOB is exactly one-to-one | 0 claims without EOB, 0 EOBs without claim, 0 duplicates; paid = 74.5% of billed, never above billed | `paid_amount` = EOB `payment.amount`; `billed_amount` = Claim `total`. Reconciled to the cent by `assert_fhir_claims_reconcile_to_bronze` | Silver, Tests |
| H12 | Conditions include social findings and highly sensitive codes | 259 distinct SNOMED codes; top codes include "Medication review due", employment status, stress, social isolation; "Victim of intimate partner abuse" 820 | CONV-4 classifies each code: billable diagnosis → ICD-10-CM; social finding → ICD-10-CM Z code where one exists; not codable → kept, unconverted. Abuse/violence findings flagged **sensitive** and masked beyond HIPAA's default in gold | Silver, Gold |
| H13 | Billed services carry no CPT/HCPCS | Claim lines: 690 distinct SNOMED, 32 LOINC, 245 RxNorm, 21 CVX codes | 837 generation (EDI-1) needs a SNOMED → CPT/HCPCS crosswalk, sized at 690 codes; RxNorm lines go to pharmacy (NCPDP), not 837 | EDI |
| H14 | Usable history starts in 2017 | 9,420–11,462 claims a year 2017–2025; 2026 partial (to Oct 13); 2015–2016 thin | Gold reporting window for FHIR starts 2017-01; 2026 reported year-to-date | Gold |
| H15 | All ages, not a Medicare-only population | 1,168 patients born 1916–2026; 168 deceased; 591 F / 577 M | Age bands in gold; Medicare eligibility never assumed from age | Gold |
| H16 | No Coverage resources in bundles | Payer appears only as `Claim.insurance.coverage.display` | FHIR enrollment comes from `payer_transitions.csv` / the 834 (EDI-3); until then the claim-to-enrollment test runs for DE-SynPUF only | Silver, Tests |

## Mapping decisions (FHIR → silver)

- **Same tables as DE-SynPUF.** `silver.member` and `silver.claim_header` union every source by column name (`macros/claim_header_columns.sql`); keys are `(source_system, id)`.
- **Identifiers separated.** Name, SSN, MRN, address and phone go to `silver.member_identity` (RESTRICTED), never to `silver.member`.
- **Local dates.** Dates are taken as written (`left(timestamp, 10)`), not converted to UTC: a 23:15 −05:00 visit stays on its own day.
- **Array elements by meaning.** JSONPath selects the official name, the SSN identifier and the US Core race/ethnicity extensions by their system/url, never by array position.
- **Diagnoses wait for CONV-4.** FHIR diagnoses are SNOMED; they enter `silver.claim_diagnosis` once converted.
